01.line: This parasite destroys a fish’s tongue… then becomes its new tongue.

02.line: Scientists gave a cockroach a diving suit… and kept it underwater for hours.

03.line: This worm drives a mantis into water… then crawls out of its body.

04.line: This metal robot melts through a cage… then gets remolded into shape.

05.line: This beetle shoots boiling chemicals… from explosions inside its own body.

06.line: This parasite turns a snail’s eyestalk into a pulsing lure for birds.

07.line: Doctors can keep a human heart beating… even after it’s removed from the body.

08.line: These contact lenses detect infrared signals… even when your eyes are closed.

09.line: This tiny shrimp snaps its claw… creating a shockwave and flash of light.

10.line: A brain implant helped this man walk again… by bypassing his spinal injury.
